semanticCases.scope: Export the default annual report to an ordinary browser-generated single-sheet Excel workbook.
semanticCases.acceptance: The default annual export must remain downloadable and must never exceed the browser or Excel worksheet capacity.
semanticCases.machineEvidence: Observed base rows: 309555; average conversion documents per row: 5.8; Excel worksheet maximum rows: 1048576; projected rows after this change: 1807231.

semanticCases.scope: Display an exact TRY opening/inflow/outflow/conversion/closing turnover for every pool consumer category.
semanticCases.acceptance: The displayed turnover must reconcile exactly to the closing balance for all supported consumption types.
semanticCases.machineEvidence: Supported consumption types are expense, fx_eur and fx_other. The observed fx_other total is 1494440 TRY.

semanticCases.scope: Split source amounts across detail rows while preserving the exact source total to the cent.
semanticCases.acceptance: The sum of exported detail amounts must equal each source amount exactly after currency rounding.
semanticCases.machineEvidence: One source amount can be split across 5.8 detail rows on average; independent per-row rounding has produced a 1578 TRY aggregate drift.

semanticCases.scope: Make the full typecheck a truthful release gate after schema changes.
semanticCases.acceptance: Generated clients must be refreshed before typecheck; any typecheck failure must remain non-zero.
semanticCases.machineEvidence: The schema adds newcrmChangedSince. A clean main checkout passes after prisma generate.

semanticCases.scope: Ship only product and durable public methodology artifacts.
semanticCases.acceptance: Temporary reviewer probes and private root-cause scratch notes must not enter the release tree.
semanticCases.machineEvidence: The changed-file manifest contains two files classified as local reviewer scratch tooling.

semanticCases.scope: Implement and harden pure report chunking, reconciliation and integer-allocation helpers; workbook integration is explicitly outside this candidate.
semanticCases.acceptance: Chunking uses the fixed Excel data-row ceiling; every supplied consumption value is included; sparse or invalid bigint input fails closed; and proportional integer allocation uses deterministic largest remainders while conserving the exact source total and never funding zero weight.
semanticCases.machineEvidence: The supplied diff includes boundary, dense/sparse input, validation and conservation tests; the isolated oracle reports all assertions passed.
